text:
deploy-bot: Canary failed in eu-west-1 for chart=payments-ui v2.3.4 -> observed 12% 5xx on canary. Signal: values checksum mismatch between canary and promoted values. Auto-pinning not engaged because values-hash differs. See details: https://deploy.redwood.internal/canaries/1764448888
nate: ugh, values drift again. is this the feature-flag toggle or something else?
olivia: saw a values override in PR #4923 — payments.timeout changed from 30s -> 15s for tenant=xyz. could explain the transient spikes on /checkout
jen: can we hotpatch a configmap instead of rolling back the whole chart? it's just a timeout and a flag
samir: hotpatch is ok for purely config changes; it's risky if there are implicit schema expectations. PR touches only feature_flag & request-timeout keys.
ara: paste helm diff output:
```
$ helm diff upgrade payments-ui ./charts/payments-ui --values values.yaml --values overrides/tenant-xyz.yaml
+ timeout: 15s
- timeout: 30s
```
nate: deploy-bot traces show spike aligns with increased concurrency. timeout reduction makes sense as cause.
olivia: proposal: manual pin chart=payments-ui to 2.3.3 in eu-west while we ship a small hotfix (2.3.5-hotfix) that reverts the timeout for tenant xyz
jen: +1 to pin + hotfix. pin buys us a stable baseline for rollback if needed.
deploy-bot: Suggested action: annotate release with `release-pin: payments-ui:2.3.3` scope=region:euwest; also recommend notifying release notes owner.
samir: i'll draft the hotpatch overlay and do an expedited PR review. we'll keep it tiny and add an explicit comment about tenant-scoped override.
ara: opened PR #4940 with overlay reverting timeout. running CI now.
nate: @oncall please ack — we'll apply the pin and then watch for metric regression
oncall-bot: @nate acknowledged. Manual pin will be applied in 2 minutes. Change window: now -> +30m (ends 176444+1800 seconds). Emergency pin override enabled.
olivia: pin applied. Monitoring dashboards: errors falling
olivia: (10m later) errors down to 1.1% from 12% pre-pin. latency normalizing.
jen: merge the hotfix when CI passes, then do a 5% canary for v2.3.5-hotfix, keep tracing headers on
deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: v2.3.5-hotfix in eu-west-1, 5% traffic. Health checks watching.
samir: traces look clean, no increase in 5xx. promoting to 25%.
olivia: promoting to 100% now. keep pin for 1 hour after full promotion then unpin
samir: updating release notes: "hotfix (2.3.5): revert tenant xyz timeout to 30s — mitigates checkout 5xx under burst traffic" — PR #4940 referenced
nate: final decision: pin applied, hotfix promoted, leave pin for safety window. follow-up action: add a preflight values checksum check to deploy bot to catch this earlier
ara: filed follow-up ticket #INT-789 to add values checksum preflight and per-tenant override alerting
olivia: thanks everyone, closing thread once unpin is scheduled.
